title: The Unused Input: The Initial State as a Conditioning Interface for Recurrent TSFMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.14357v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast unseen series without task-specific training. Increasingly they are built on recurrent backbones, whose constant per-step cost makes long-context inference cheap, and which, unlike transformers, carry a state. A recurrent backbone computes its prediction from two inputs: the observed context window and the initial recurrent state. In practice only the first is utilised and the initial state is unused by convention. We ask whether the initial state can be utilised in recurrent TSFMs. Using the xLSTM-based zero-shot forecaster TiRex as a case study, we freeze the backbone and train only a small head that writes a context vector into the initial state, so that any change in accuracy is attributable to the injected state rather than to adapted weights. A spectral summary of the input window, learned once and applied unchanged to every series, lowers mean GiftEval MASE by 0.175%, with every seed

translated_title: 未被利用的输入：将初始状态作为循环时间序列基础模型的条件化接口
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）无需任务特定训练即可对未见过的序列进行预测。它们越来越多地构建于循环骨干网络之上，这类骨干网络每步计算成本恒定，使长上下文推理代价低廉，并且与Transformer不同，它们携带一个状态。循环骨干网络从两个输入计算其预测：观测到的上下文窗口和初始循环状态。在实践中，通常只利用了前者，而初始状态按惯例未被使用。我们探讨初始状态能否在循环TSFMs中被利用。以基于xLSTM的零样本预测器TiRex作为案例研究，我们冻结骨干网络，仅训练一个小型头部模块，将上下文向量写入初始状态，从而使任何准确率的变化都可归因于注入的状态而非权重调整。对输入窗口的频谱摘要只需学习一次并以不变的方式应用于每个序列，即可将GiftEval的平均MASE降低0.175%，且在每个随机种子下均……
tldr: 该论文揭示循环时间序列基础模型中被闲置的初始状态可作为条件化接口：冻结TiRex骨干并仅训练一个小模块将输入窗口的频谱摘要写入初始状态，即可降低GiftEval上的MASE。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the conventionally unused initial recurrent state of recurrent time series foundation models can serve as a conditioning interface: freezing the TiRex backbone and training only a small head that writes a spectral summary of the input window into the initial state lowers mean GiftEval MASE.
